title: Space Worm 3D
description: Steer an evolving neon cosmic worm through expanding stages, swallow planets and stars for permanent powers, outmaneuver increasingly aggressive rivals, and survive asteroids, energy gates and gravity wells in free-for-all or team battles.

defaultCaptions.x: I just swallowed a star in Space Worm 3D 🪐 Grow, boost and devour the cosmos — how long can you get?
defaultCaptions.facebook: Space Worm 3D: a neon cosmic arena where you grow by eating energy and swallowing planets for permanent powers. Free-for-all or team battles, right in your browser.
defaultCaptions.reddit: Space Worm 3D — a 3D snake-growth arena game in the browser: swallow celestial bodies for permanent powers, dodge asteroids, energy gates and gravity wells.
defaultCaptions.discord: Come play Space Worm 3D with me — grow, boost and devour the cosmos. Beat my peak length!
